data.body:
AC EVIDENCE, verified against merged main (Gerrit 2080, 2086, 2096).

AC1 exactly one nested-pytest launch site: test_nested_pytest_uniqueness.py::test_the_launch_appears_only_in_the_helper passes. Worth noting the criterion's own aside proved right - it specifies an AST scan because 'a source grep would pass vacuously', and this guard has already earned that: it fired on story 73b8's new tests/unit/test_timeout_budget.py, which had launched python -m pytest directly, and that change was rerouted through the helper before landing. The guard caught a real second copy within hours of merging.
AC2 exactly one helper definition: grep -rl '^def run_nested_pytest' tests/ counts 1.
AC3 basetemp owned by the caller's tmp_path: test_the_child_basetemp_is_owned_by_the_caller passes.
AC4 --basetemp spelled in exactly two modules (twelve before): the count is 2 - the helper and the unconverted test_scripts_import_convention.py, so both console-script sites survive.
AC5 caller env forwarded byte-identically: test_the_caller_environment_is_forwarded_verbatim passes.
AC6 timeout reaches subprocess.run as a keyword, CompletedProcess returned unmodified: test_repo_isolation_deadline_heldout.py, 2 passed, unedited.
AC7 TimeoutExpired propagates: test_a_timeout_propagates_to_the_caller passes. (AC1-AC7 helper/uniqueness suites together: 11 passed.)
AC8 per-site divergences preserved with no assertion edit: 59 passed / 2 skipped across six of the converted modules run locally. The deletions in the landed diff are the duplicated launcher blocks themselves - I inspected test_engine_dir.py and they are the 'import subprocess/sys; child_basetemp = ...; cp = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", ...])' stanza replaced by the helper import. No assertion was touched.
AC9 make lint exits 0. AC10 make typecheck exits 0.
AC11 PYTEST_DEBUG_TEMPROOT reaches the parity-collection child and it stays importable by name; AC12 it reaches the store-isolation child: 5 passed across test_ci_workflow_parity_basetemp.py and test_test_suite_store_isolation.py, both unchanged.
AC13 the converted files pass the default Verified tier, the --dist loadgroup lane and the integration tier: checked by CI, which returned Verified +1 on all three landed changes.
